title: Siman 387
section: The Virtue of His Torah and His Holy Books

segments.he: לְהִתְבּוֹדֵד, וְלִמֵּד אוֹתוֹ לוֹמַר לִפְנֵי הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ רִבּוֹנוֹ שֶׁל עוֹלָם רַחֵם עָלַי וְכוּ' כִּי
segments.en: (49.) This pertains to the matter where he said that in the discourse Bikrov Sham [Likutay Moharan, Torah 362] there is the intention of Kiddush. Afterwards I heard that the intentions of Kiddush are truly in the discourse Bikrov Alai HaSheni [Likutay Moharan Tinyana, Torah 101].
